root_cause: The workspace volume had no free space for the initial source fetch. Git reported ENOSPC while indexing the new pack.
evidence: The first checkout failed before editorial source writes. The scoped remote HEAD was subsequently confirmed and opened from a matching isolated checkout on a volume with free space. Build, production deployment and article readback passed.
mitigation: Used an isolated checkout with adequate free storage and the exact current source. No production rollback was needed.
next_action: Check available checkout volume before a full source fetch and reuse matching source objects when available.
